title: Build BELKRISHNA GlobalEdge Career Guidance Program web app (registration, assessments, scoring, editable reports, storage)

requirements.text: Implement student registration and user account management using Internet Identity login on the frontend, and persist a student profile in the Motoko backend keyed by the authenticated principal (create on first login, fetch/update on subsequent logins).

quotes: You asked for a complete system that includes all 150 assessment questions, a full editable report format, a website workflow, and an app that delivers the entire BELKRISHNA GlobalEdge Career Guidance Program. I’ll build an app that handles student registration...

acceptanceCriteria: A user can sign in with Internet Identity and see their profile information
Backend stores and returns a profile record for the signed-in principal
A user can update basic profile fields and see them persisted after refresh/re-login

requirements.text: Create the full test-taking workflow to deliver all 150 assessment questions in the React app, including: start assessment, progress indicator, navigating questions, saving responses, review screen, submission/finish, and preventing data loss on refresh by loading the in-progress session state from the backend.

quotes: ...includes all 150 assessment questions... runs the tests... stores everything for easy retrieval.

acceptanceCriteria: The UI presents an assessment flow with question navigation and progress
Responses are persisted to the backend during the session (not only at the end)
Refreshing the page resumes the latest in-progress session for the signed-in user

requirements.text: Implement automated scoring/assessment logic in the Motoko backend for the 150-question assessment, producing a structured score output that can be used to generate a career guidance report; expose backend methods to compute and retrieve scores for a completed session.
acceptanceCriteria: Completing an assessment session triggers a deterministic score computation in the backend
Scores for a completed session can be retrieved via a backend query call
Scores are persisted and still retrievable after canister redeploy (stable storage)

requirements.text: Generate a detailed career guidance report after scoring, and provide a fully editable report format in the frontend (rich sections/fields editable by an authorized user) with backend persistence for edits and versioning metadata (e.g., last updated time, updated by).

quotes: ...generates detailed career reports... full editable report format...

acceptanceCriteria: After completing scoring, a report is created and viewable for that session
A user can edit report fields in the UI and save changes
Reloading the report shows the saved edits and updated timestamps

requirements.text: Implement persistent storage and retrieval for student test sessions, responses, computed scores, and generated reports in the single Motoko actor, including backend APIs to list a student's historical sessions/reports and fetch any specific record by ID with access control enforcing that only the owning principal (or an explicitly defined admin role) can access it.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend can list all sessions/reports for the signed-in principal
Backend rejects access to another principal’s sessions/reports
Stored sessions/reports remain available after canister upgrade (stable storage)

requirements.text: Create the end-to-end website workflow in the frontend for the BELKRISHNA GlobalEdge program, including: landing/dashboard, student onboarding/profile, assessments list, active assessment experience, results/scores view, report viewer/editor, and history screen for past sessions and reports.

quotes: ...a website workflow, and an app that delivers the entire BELKRISHNA GlobalEdge Career Guidance Program.

acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in user can navigate from dashboard to start an assessment
After completion, the user can view scores and open the generated report
The user can browse a history list and reopen past reports

requirements.text: Apply a coherent, creative visual theme across the frontend (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a career guidance/education product, and enforce it consistently across all pages and states.
acceptanceCriteria: All primary screens share a consistent typography and color system
Interactive states (hover/focus/disabled) are styled consistently
Layout is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Add generated static image assets required by the app into frontend/public/assets/generated and render them appropriately in the UI (e.g., in the landing and/or dashboard screens) without routing images through the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames
Frontend loads these images as static assets and displays them without backend calls

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not modify immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Integrations with third-party authentication providers other than Internet Identity
External databases or off-platform storage services

required: Minimal, modern education/career guidance logo mark with neutral palette (belkrishna-logo.dim_512x512.png)
Clean vector-style hero illustration showing a student planning a career path with abstract shapes (career-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
